arxiv-2103-05239.title: Transfer matrix study of the Anderson transition in non-Hermitian systems
arxiv-2103-05239.creator: Xunlong Luo, Tomi Ohtsuki, Ryuichi Shindou
arxiv-2103-05239.description: Abstract The Anderson transition driven by non-Hermitian (NH) disorder has been extensively studied in recent years. In this paper, we present in-depth transfer matrix analyses of the Anderson transition in three NH systems, NH Anderson, U(1), and Peierls models in three-dimensional systems.

arxiv-2112-09365.description: Abstract . Cannabis is one of the most common mind-altering substances. It is used both medicinally and recreationally and is enmeshed in a complex and changing legal landscape. Anecdotal evidence suggests that some software developers may use cannabis to aid some programming tasks.

arxiv-2312-02591.title: General spatio-temporal factor models for high-dimensional random fields on a lattice
arxiv-2312-02591.creator: Matteo Barigozzilabel=e1]matteo.barigozzi@unibo.it, Davide La Vecchialabel=e2]Davide.LaVecchia@unige.ch, Hang Liulabel=e3]hliu01@ustc.edu.cn

We call it General Spatio-Temporal Factor Model (GSTFM).

arxiv-2412-17402.title: Magnetic helicity fluxes in dynamos from rotating inhomogeneous turbulence
arxiv-2412-17402.creator: Axel Brandenburg, Ethan T. Vishniac
arxiv-2412-17402.description: Abstract We analyze direct numerical simulations of large-scale dynamos in inhomogeneous nonhelically driven rotating turbulence with and without shear. The forcing is modulated so that the turbulent intensity peaks in the middle of the computational domain and drops to nearly zero at the two ends above and below the midplane.

arxiv-2508-00110.title: funOCLUST: Clustering Functional Data with Outliers
arxiv-2508-00110.creator: Katharine M. Clark, Paul D. McNicholas
arxiv-2508-00110.description: Abstract Functional data present unique challenges for clustering due to their infinite-dimensional nature and potential sensitivity to outliers. An extension of the OCLUST algorithm to the functional setting is proposed to address these issues. The approach leverages the OCLUST framework, creating a robust method to cluster curves and trim outliers.

pmc-12514595.title: Evaluation of subclinical atherosclerosis in women with polycystic ovary syndrome based on ultra-high-frequency ultrasound and vector flow imaging
pmc-12514595.creator: Yinghui Dong, Shaofu Hong, Zimo Wang, Di Song, Mengmeng Liu, Jieying Zeng, Yigang Du, Jinfeng Xu, Liyun Shi, Wenjing Gao, Fajin Dong
pmc-12514595.description: BackgroundThe diagnosis of subclinical atherosclerosis is the key to the primary prevention of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (CVD). Considering the increased risk of CVD in women with polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS), the purpose of this study was to detect the early damage of the carotid artery in PCOS patients using carotid ultra-high frequency ultrasound (UHFUS) and vector flow imaging (V Flow).

pmc-12623246.title: Non-genetic inactivation of caspase-3 and P53 increases cancer cell fitness by PDIA4 redistribution
pmc-12623246.creator: Gal Twito, Faiza Amterat Abu Abayed, Ayelet Gilad, Suma Biadsy, Noa Gavriel, Suad Sheikh Suliman, Yarden Mizrahi, Hila Megged, Mor Tenenboim, Naim Abu-Freha, Aeid Igbaria
pmc-12623246.description: Numerous cellular pathways are known to cause resistance in cancer cells. The unfolded protein response (UPR), a signaling pathway activated during proteostasis stress in the endoplasmic reticulum (ER), is an adaptive process to increase cancer cell fitness. However, the molecular mechanism between ER stress, UPR activation, and chemoresistance is insufficiently understood.

pmc-13208136.title: Dimensional Stability of Polymer and Titanium Implant Scan Bodies After Repeated Steam Sterilization: A High-Resolution 3D Metrological In Vitro Study
pmc-13208136.creator: Igor Smojver, Roko Bjelica, Yuval Reiser, Marko Vuletić, Vladimir Prpić, Dragana Gabrić
pmc-13208136.description: The increasing adoption of digital workflows in implant dentistry relies heavily on the accuracy of implant scan bodies (ISBs), which may be affected by repeated sterilization. This in vitro study evaluated the effect of 50 steam sterilization cycles on the dimensional stability of polymer and titanium ISBs.

pmc-13674539.title: Potential explanations for the observed cardiovascular risk profile in military personnel: a narrative review
pmc-13674539.creator: Magdalena Zawadzka, Ewelina Ejchman-Pac, Justyna Marszałkowska-Jakubik
pmc-13674539.description: Cardiovascular diseases (CVD) remain the leading cause of mortality in Poland and constitute a major public health burden. While traditional risk factors are well described in the general population, less is known about their distribution in specific occupational groups, including military personnel, who may be exposed to unique work-related cardiovascular risk factors.

pmc-13679006.title: Effects and moderators of a 16-week intervention on contextual physical activity in adults with moderate to severe depressive symptoms: short and long-term results of a randomized clinical trial
pmc-13679006.creator: Cecília Bertuol, Kelly Samara Silva, Marcus Vinicius Veber Lopes, Deborah Kazimoto Alves, Caroline Soares da Silva, Marcelo Baggio do Amaral, Anne Ribeiro Streb, Giovani Firpo Del Duca
pmc-13679006.description: BackgroundDepression is associated with reduced physical activity (PA), and evidence on the long-term effects of interventions and their potential moderators remains limited. Thus, this study aimed to evaluate the short- (post-intervention) and long-term (six-month follow-up) effects of a PA-promoting intervention on contextual PA and to explore potential moderators in adults with depressive symptoms.

uslaw-usc-t16-s410hhhh4.title: 16 U.S.C. § 410hhhh–4 — Management plan
uslaw-usc-t16-s410hhhh4.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s410hhhh4.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 1 (National Parks, Military Parks, Monuments, And Seashores); Subchapter LIX–FFF (Jimmy Carter National Historical Park). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Not later than 3 years after December 23, 1987, the Secretary shall develop and submit to the Congress a general management plan for the use and development of the historical park and the preservation district.

uslaw-usc-t22-s501.title: 22 U.S.C. § 501 — Utilization of services of Government agencies to promote inter-American relations
uslaw-usc-t22-s501.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t22-s501.description: United States Code, Title 22 (Foreign Relations And Intercourse); Chapter 10 (Hemispheral Relations); Subchapter I (Generally). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In order to render closer and more effective the relationship between the American republics the President of the United States is authorized, subject to such appropriations as are made available for the purpose, to utilize the services of the departments, agencies.
